resources.name: sets
resources.description: One row per catalogue set: what its fields are, what its kinds name, what it is for and who uses it.

fields.name: set
fields.description: The catalogue set.

fields.name: prefix
fields.description: What a lookup writes before ':' to ask this set alone, as c:q_value; v is reserved for the vendor's own column.

fields.name: definition
fields.description: What the set's fields are.

fields.name: kind_definition
fields.description: What a kind names in this set.

fields.name: purpose
fields.description: What the set is for.

fields.name: used_by
fields.description: Who uses the set, separated by ';'.

resources.name: terms
resources.description: The root of a catalogue: the terms each set defines, before any software maps them. A term is a key at one location: what callers ask by, the kind it stands for, the qualifier values it fixes and how strongly consumers need it. One row per term and qualifier value its key fixes; a key that fixes none has one row with neither. catalog.csv maps terms to fields; a term no row maps yet is reported as a warning.

fields.name: set
fields.description: The catalogue set.

fields.name: location
fields.description: Where the term applies, as <level>/<attribute>: peptidoform_ion/layers. level: the quantification level, or * for every level, which only annotation and app entries use. attribute: obs, var, layers or varm.

fields.name: key
fields.description: The name callers ask by.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: What the term measures; one of the set's kinds. The same on every row of the key.

fields.name: qualifier
fields.description: A qualifier whose value the key fixes, such as normalization; one row per fixed qualifier. Empty with value when the key fixes none.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The value the key fixes for that qualifier, as intensity fixes normalization none. A key fixes the same values at every location.

fields.name: requirement
fields.description: How strongly the set's consumers need the term at this location: required, recommended or optional; empty when none is stated. The same on every row of the term.

fields.name: psi_ms
fields.description: PSI-MS terms for the key's meaning, separated by ';'; may be empty. The same on every row of the key.

fields.name: definition
fields.description: What the term means, in words, such as unnormalized ion intensity; may be empty.

resources.name: kinds
resources.description: The kinds of each set: what an entry or key stands for; a kind is always known. A set declared in sets.csv alone, while planned, has none.

fields.name: set
fields.description: The catalogue set.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: The kind defined.

fields.name: definition
fields.description: What the kind means.

resources.name: qualifiers
resources.description: The qualifiers of each set that refine a kind, such as normalization or unit.

fields.name: set
fields.description: The catalogue set.

fields.name: qualifier
fields.description: The qualifier defined; never kind.

fields.name: definition
fields.description: What the qualifier records.

resources.name: qualifier_values
resources.description: The values each qualifier admits, unknown among them once it admits any.

fields.name: set
fields.description: The catalogue set.

fields.name: qualifier
fields.description: The qualifier.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The value defined.

fields.name: definition
fields.description: What the value means.

resources.name: catalog
resources.description: One row per mapping of a term to a field and per qualifier: where the field lives in an APB result, the term's key, and the field's value of one qualifier; a field has one row per qualifier of its set, three in abundance. kind, psi_ms and fixed repeat what terms.csv states for the key, so each row reads alone; a field's basis and evidence_url are the same on all its rows.

fields.name: set
fields.description: The catalogue set.

fields.name: software
fields.description: Who writes the field and for which versions, as <source>/<version>: DIA-NN/2.x. source: the conversion software, an app named in producers, or annotation:<convention>. version: one versions.csv label, or * for every version.

fields.name: location
fields.description: Where in the result, as <level>/<attribute>: protein/var. level: the quantification level, or * for every level, which only annotation and app entries use. attribute: obs, var, layers or varm.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The field, as <key>/<column>: -/Lib_PG_Q_Value, a var column; PG_MaxLFQ/-, a layer; fasta_validation/is_proteotypic, a varm table's column. key: a layer or varm table, - for obs and var. column: an obs, var or varm column, - for a layer; a trailing * matches every obs column starting with it.

fields.name: key
fields.description: The term the field answers: a key terms.csv defines at this location.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: The kind the key stands for, as terms.csv states it.

fields.name: qualifier
fields.description: One qualifier of the set refining the kind, such as normalization or unit; a field has one row per qualifier of its set. Empty with value when the set has none.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The field's value of that qualifier.

fields.name: fixed
fields.description: true where the key fixes this qualifier's value, as terms.csv states, and the row carries that value; false where the key leaves the qualifier open, and on a row without a qualifier.

fields.name: psi_ms
fields.description: PSI-MS terms for the key's meaning, as terms.csv states them; may be empty.

fields.name: basis
fields.description: Why the reviewer assigned this meaning; the same on every row of the field.

fields.name: evidence_url
fields.description: Where the basis can be checked; may be empty.

resources.name: producers
resources.description: Apps that write fields after conversion, such as apb-fasta, and the run that must record them before their fields exist.

fields.name: set
fields.description: The catalogue set.

fields.name: producer
fields.description: The app, as named in entries' source.

fields.name: requires
fields.description: The result metadata path, joined by '.', that records the app's run.

fields.name: instruction
fields.description: What to run before the app's fields exist.

resources.name: versions
resources.description: The software versions APB2 has a rule for, written from APB2's packaged rules when the catalog is written: each version's label, which entries name, and the rule's version pattern, which a converted result stores. A version's levels are the levels its entries name.

fields.name: software
fields.description: The software name APB2's rule declares.

fields.name: version
fields.description: The version range's label, as entries name it.

fields.name: software_version_pattern
fields.description: The rule's software version pattern, as a converted result stores it.
